feedback: The illustration beautifully captures Jesus standing peacefully on the Galilean fishing boat with his disciples preparing the oars and ropes under a warm sunset glow, matching the text perfectly.
The stormy sea and anxious disciples match the text well, though Jesus is already standing calmly to still the storm rather than emphasizing solely the disciples' terror.
The illustration depicts the disciples bailing water from the boat in a rainstorm, though the atmosphere is calmer than the extreme peril described in the text.
The illustration perfectly captures Jesus sleeping serenely on a pillow at the stern of the boat amidst the violent waves and stormy sea, contrasting with the terrified disciples.
The illustration captures the stormy sea, the panicked disciples frantically shouting and shaking Jesus, and Jesus peacefully resting on a pillow in the boat.
The illustration captures Jesus standing resolutely on the boat amid the stormy sea with calm composure.
The illustration beautifully captures Jesus standing with divine authority in the boat, raising his hand to calm the turbulent waves and wind as described in the text.
The illustration perfectly captures Jesus standing peacefully at the boat's prow over calm, glassy waters under a serene, moonlit night sky as described.
The illustration perfectly captures Jesus gently addressing his disciples on a tranquil, moonlit boat while they gaze back in profound awe with water dripping from their clothes.
